 What you'll do...Role summary:
   

  

 Join Walmart as a Distinguished Software Engineer, leading the design and development of scalable, reliable software solutions aligned with business objectives. This role involves analyzing complex requirements, driving architectural decisions, and guiding teams through agile methodologies to deliver high\-quality, maintainable code. The successful candidate will champion operational excellence, mentor peers, and innovate across cloud\-native platforms while ensuring security and performance standards. By collaborating cross\-functionally, this position supports continuous improvement and the advancement of Walmart’s technology landscape to meet evolving customer and business needs.
   

  

 About the team:
   

  

 The People Technology team at Walmart builds and enhances people\-focused technology impacting millions of associates worldwide. The Apps, Analytics, and AI team powers scalable platforms for AI Agents, enterprise insights, and application journeys across People Tech, including the Me@ platform, Walmart’s flagship associate experience app. The team also advances the People Data Platform, delivering secure, governed data foundations for analytics, AI, and automation. By combining modern data architecture, AI/ML, and platform engineering, the team delivers intelligent, scalable solutions that enhance associate experiences and drive operational excellence.
   

  

 What you'll do: Lead technical strategy and architecture across the AAA Platform, aligning solutions to business priorities and MVP goals. Drive cross\-domain alignment within People Tech and across Enterprise Technology (Me@, Data Platform, Security, Infrastructure) to ensure scalable, interoperable platforms. Design secure, reliable, and extensible architectures meeting functional and nonfunctional requirements. Ensure high\-quality engineering through strong coding standards, testing strategy, CI/CD excellence, and observability. Mentor leaders and engineers, foster innovation, and drive adoption of modern engineering and AI best practices.
   

  

 What you'll bring: Extensive experience in software architecture, distributed systems, and scalable platform design. Proficiency in analyzing and scoping complex requirements aligned with business objectives. Strong knowledge of coding standards, multiple programming languages, and modern development frameworks. Expertise in designing modular, extensible, and maintainable software solutions. Proven ability to lead and mentor engineering teams, fostering continuous learning and innovation. Skilled in driving CI/CD pipelines, telemetry, and operational due diligence for reliable deployments. Adept at root cause analysis, defect management, and improving application performance and security.
